{"reason": "The medium/high branch always paid 45k for supplier-switches: wasted when inventory>=10 (rows 10.0, 11.5, 12.4, 13.2: regular lead 4-8 arrives first) and still 195k+stockout when tight (2.8, 5.3). Expedite (35k) always arrives on time and strictly dominates the 45k supplier, so medium/high with inventory-days<10 now expedites; roomy inventory monitors.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (< inventory-days 10)
          (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
